title: Cut-over and rollback
description:
Stage the new build on the staging host, compare sitemap and sample pages, switch the production origin, keep the previous origin ready (the edge template infra/edge/threat-intelligence-amplify-origin.yaml pattern), and write the rollback steps. Watch the CloudFront TTL; no blanket invalidation.
Scenario: A bad cut-over can be reversed
  Given the new site is live
  When the previous origin is restored
  Then readers see the old site within the TTL and no URL returns an error

Depends on: PPY-1192d3 (staging tenant).
